newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Palestinian leader Arafat to visit Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian leader Arafat to visit Portugal.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat has accepted an invitation to visit Portugal in November, a presidency spokesman said on Thursday.
"This personal invitation from President Jorge Sampaio has been accepted," spokesman Joao Gabriel said.
"The visit will be in November, perhaps in the middle of the month, but there is no exact date yet," he said.
"The invitation is a signal of Portugal's hopes for progress in the Middle East peace process," the spokesman added.
